name: Robert Sterling
description: Eldest brother in Georgia embroiled in a bitter, 10-year multi-sibling dispute over parents' estate.
quirks: Details decades of family arguments and grievances going back to childhood
Mentions two sisters who refuse to speak to him or sign deed
Needs focus on the actual property title and probate status

hidden_case.goal: Partition and sell inherited family farmland or buy out sisters' shares
facts: Parents died without a will in Savannah, Georgia, leaving 40 acres of rural land
Robert has paid all property taxes ($4,200/year) and maintenance alone for 6 years
Two sisters refuse to contribute to taxes and refuse to consent to selling the land
timeline: 2019-2024: Robert paid all county property taxes
Last month: County threatened tax lien if upcoming taxes aren't paid
people: Sisters: Patricia Sterling and Claire Sterling-Jones
documents: County deed showing deceased parents as title holders
6 years of paid property tax receipts ($25,200 total)
deadlines: Dec 20: County property tax payment deadline
